title: RSSB Teaching Associate Recruitment 2026: 3,540 Posts Open - Apply by June 3
author: Ash K.
excerpt: Rajasthan Staff Selection Board has released notification for 3,540 Teaching Associate contractual posts across 32 subjects under Raj-CES. Applications open May 5 to June 3, 2026.
key_stat: 3,540 posts | Master's + NET/SET/Ph.D. | Rs 28,850/month | Last date: June 3, 2026
body: Rajasthan Staff Selection Board (RSSB) has officially released Advertisement No. 06/2026 for direct recruitment of 3,540 Teaching Associate (contractual) posts under Rajasthan College Education Society (Raj-CES). The online application window opened on May 5, 2026 and will remain open until June 3, 2026 at rssb.rajasthan.gov.in.

The recruitment covers 32 subjects including English, Hindi, Geography, Political Science, Economics, History, Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Botany, Zoology, Law, Sanskrit, Urdu, and multiple agriculture-related disciplines like Horticulture, Agricultural Engineering, Agronomy, and Soil Science.

Selected candidates will receive a fixed monthly remuneration of Rs 28,850 per month under the Raj-CES contractual hiring rules. The written examination is tentatively scheduled for August-October 2026.

Eligibility: Master's degree in the relevant subject with minimum 55% marks from a recognized university, plus NET, SET, SLET, or Ph.D. qualification as per Raj-CES norms. Age limit is 21-40 years as on January 1, 2027, with standard relaxations for OBC (3 years), SC/ST (5 years), and PwD candidates.

Application fee is Rs 600 for General and OBC Creamy Layer candidates, and Rs 400 for OBC-NCL, SC, ST, EWS, and PwD candidates. Payment is accepted online via debit card, credit card, net banking, UPI, or mobile wallet.

To apply, candidates must log in through the Rajasthan SSO portal at sso.rajasthan.gov.in. Navigate to the Recruitment Portal, select Advertisement No. 06/2026, complete the One Time Registration if not already done, fill in all personal and academic details, upload required documents, pay the fee, and submit before June 3.

The selection process includes a written examination conducted through CBT, TBT, or OMR method carrying 375 marks. Negative marking of 1/3 mark applies for each wrong answer. Candidates must secure minimum 36% marks in each paper to qualify.

This is one of the largest single-notification teaching recruitments in India this year. Postgraduates with NET/SET/Ph.D. qualification from Rajasthan and across India should not miss this opportunity. The Rs 28,850 monthly salary is contractual but provides a foothold in Rajasthan's college education system with potential for future regularization.

callout.heading: Apply through Rajasthan SSO portal before June 3
callout.content: Visit rssb.rajasthan.gov.in → Login via SSO → Recruitment Portal → Select Advt. No. 06/2026. Complete OTR first if you're a new applicant. Ensure your live photograph is captured through the OTR system. Application correction costs Rs 300 extra - fill details carefully the first time.

faqs.question: What is the salary for RSSB Teaching Associate 2026?
faqs.answer: Selected candidates will receive a fixed monthly remuneration of Rs 28,850 per month on contractual basis under Raj-CES hiring rules. The amount is subject to revision as per Rajasthan government orders.

faqs.question: Is NET/SET mandatory for RSSB Teaching Associate?
faqs.answer: NET, SET, SLET, or Ph.D. qualification is required as per Raj-CES rules. Candidates should check the specific subject-wise requirements in the official notification as criteria may vary by subject.

faqs.question: How many vacancies are there in RSSB Teaching Associate 2026?
faqs.answer: A total of 3,540 Teaching Associate posts have been announced across 32 subjects including arts, science, commerce, law, and agriculture disciplines.

faqs.question: What is the last date to apply for RSSB Teaching Associate 2026?
faqs.answer: The last date to submit the online application is June 3, 2026 (11:59 PM). Applications must be submitted through the Rajasthan SSO portal at recruitment.rajasthan.gov.in.
